Illumina_WGS.label: Illumina WGS
Illumina_WGS.note: The sample's own short reads. HGSVC rows marked nygc_30x are the 1kGP NYGC 30x data.

Illumina_parents.label: Trio parent Illumina
Illumina_parents.note: Parents' reads stored under the child's directory, for trio phasing.

HiFi_5mC.label: HiFi 5mC (CpG)
HiFi_5mC.note: 5mC from PacBio kinetics. Usually inline MM/ML tags in the ordinary HiFi BAM.

ONT_5mC.label: ONT 5mC / 5hmC
ONT_5mC.note: Modified-base calls from dorado (inline MM/ML tags) or nanopolish (HGSVC).

WholeBlood.label: Whole-blood data
WholeBlood.note: Data from whole blood rather than the LCL, so it can be compared with the LCL.

iPSC.label: iPSC data
iPSC.note: Data from induced pluripotent stem cells.

MAGE_RNA.label: MAGE RNA-seq
MAGE_RNA.note: LCL RNA-seq of 731 1kGP donors, Taylor et al. 2024 (PRJNA851328).
